assumption_status: Analyst-defined stress-test domain, not empirical calibration or a probability distribution
rate_explanation: g corresponds to ordinary annual activity growth 2–6%; b to ordinary baseline intensity improvement 0–2%. theta is additional realized advantage relative to the improving baseline, not an engine-only gain. r is fuel-use-weighted adoption of the additional advantage. tau is an assumed delay in years.
horizon_explanation: 2025 observed baseline to 2040; target holds reconstructed fuel use at the baseline level, not a claim about an official policy target or climate neutrality.
parameter_rationale: Activity and baseline-rate ranges are transparent exploratory choices; observed historical rates will be reported alongside them without treating disruption/recovery changes as technology trends. Literature motivates deployment uncertainty but does not calibrate these China-specific bounds. Technology, adoption and delays are explicitly hypothetical. No financial optimum or real-world target probability is estimated.
